author: PokerFace
body:
I would just like to say this an appeal for NovaLikesPvP, Since he is forum-banned as well, I am putting his appeal on the forums for him.

Username: NovaLikesPvP
Reason for temp-ban: DDos Threats/Harassment
Reason for appeal: Hi, I have been waiting for about 5 months and I'm very sorry for saying ddos threats. It won't happen again. I like to play on Avicus and enjoy playing Nebula. Thank you.
